title: Identification of Mycobacterium bovis by LAMP targeting RD12 of M. tuberculosis complex
author: Sierra, Camelo, et al.

steps.title: Isolate Mycobacterial Genomic DNA
steps.instruction: Extract DNA from a 10 mL stationary‑phase Mycobacterium bovis culture using a multi‑step chemical lysis and organic extraction protocol.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge 10 mL culture at 8,500 rpm for 15 min; discard supernatant.
Resuspend pellet in 500 µL 1× TE (10 mM Tris‑HCl, 10 mM EDTA, pH 8.0) and heat at 85 °C for 20 min.
Add lysozyme to a final concentration of 10 mg/µL; incubate at 37 °C for 8 h.
Add SDS to 10 % (v/v) and proteinase K to 10 mg/µL; incubate at 65 °C for 1 h.
Add 4 M NaCl and pre‑heated (65 °C) CTAB/NaCl solution (volume not specified); incubate at 65 °C for 45 min.
Add one volume of isoamyl‑alcohol:chloroform (24:1); vortex briefly and centrifuge at 13,000 rpm for 10 min at room temperature.
Transfer the aqueous phase to a new tube; add RNase to 20 mg/µL and incubate at 37 °C for 15 min.
Repeat the isoamyl‑alcohol:chloroform extraction and centrifugation as above; transfer the aqueous phase.
Add 100 µL of 3 M sodium acetate, then add one volume of isopropyl alcohol; mix and incubate at –20 °C overnight.
Centrifuge at 13,000 rpm for 15 min at 4 °C; discard supernatant.
Add two volumes of cold ethanol; incubate at –20 °C for 1 h.
Centrifuge at 13,000 rpm for 15 min; discard supernatant.
Wash the pellet twice with 70 % ethanol, discarding supernatant each wash.
Dry the pellet at 37 °C for 30 min.
Resuspend the dried DNA pellet in 1× TE buffer.

steps.title: Assess DNA Quality and Quantity
steps.instruction: Verify integrity of the extracted DNA and determine its concentration.

substeps.instruction: Run 1 % agarose gel electrophoresis in 1× TAE buffer (40 mM Tris, 20 mM acetate, 1 mM EDTA, pH 8.3) and visualize bands.
Measure DNA concentration using a NanoDrop OneC UV–Vis spectrophotometer (Thermo Scientific).

steps.title: Prepare LAMP Reaction Mix
steps.instruction: Assemble a 25 µL colorimetric LAMP reaction using the WarmStart® Colorimetric LAMP 2X Master Mix and RD12 primers.

substeps.instruction: Add the volume of 2X master mix required for a 25 µL final reaction (as per manufacturer’s protocol).
Add the six RD12 primers at the concentration recommended by the manufacturer (or up to three‑fold higher, which gave identical results).
Add the DNA template (up to the amount tested, e.g., 50 fg–250 ng) to reach a total volume of 25 µL.
Add nuclease‑free water to bring the mixture to exactly 25 µL.

steps.title: Incubate LAMP Reaction
steps.instruction: Amplify the target DNA under isothermal conditions.

substeps.instruction: Place the reaction tubes in a heat block or water bath set to 65 °C.
Incubate for 30 min (no longer than 30 min to avoid false‑positive color change).

steps.title: Interpret Colorimetric Result
steps.instruction: Determine positivity by visual inspection of the reaction color.

substeps.instruction: If the reaction turns yellow (phenol red acidified), record as positive for M. bovis DNA.
If the reaction remains red, record as negative.
